# Surrogacy Expert

Surrogacy Expert is an educational resource for intended parents pursuing gestational surrogacy in the United States.

## Primary topics
- Surrogacy costs and budgeting
- Surrogacy cost by state
- Surrogacy agency fees
- Finding available surrogates
- Finding and evaluating a surrogate
- Choosing a surrogacy agency
- Legal process and parentage
- IVF and embryo transfer
- Surrogacy insurance
- Surrogacy laws by state
- LGBTQ+ and single-parent surrogacy
- International intended parents
- Surrogacy timelines and matching

## Editorial note
Cost figures are directional planning ranges synthesized from publicly available program pricing and state-level guides. Available-surrogate inventories should not be treated as representative market-price samples because longer-unmatched, higher-priced profiles can be overrepresented. Content is educational and should not be treated as individualized medical, legal, tax, or financial advice.
